topic: Resolution cocycles versus standard connecting classes
status: Generic comparison proved and validated. Direct named Aglib generator/quotient-transport instantiation remains a separately identified source correspondence task.
provenance: New lower interface required for the native Aglib/Motivic-derived principal Ext migration; not claimed as a literal source declaration. All constructions use pinned Mathlib objects and previously proved cone sign interface.

declarations.scope: For any cochain complex K and short complex S, maps b:K0->S2, c:K(-1)->S1 with dc=0 and cf=db construct a native cone lift. Its composition with descShortComplex is any augmentation with the specified degree-zero component; its third-arrow composition represents -c.
Localizing the actual cone square yields Q(pi) followed by single-delta equal to the negative cocycle shifted map, including Q.commShiftIso.
In any abelian category and arbitrary HasExt universe, for P resolving S.X3 and S short exact, if b:P0->S2 lifts augmentation, c:P1->S1 satisfies cf=d10 b and d21 c=0, then P.extMk c = -hS.extClass.

mathematical_scope.hypotheses: Arbitrary abelian category; independent HasExt universe for final theorem. No commutative ring, module, Noetherian, finiteness, coefficient regularity or bounded-resolution assumption.
mathematical_scope.sign: Negative, established by a checked proof from the pinned native cone triangle; not an assumed convention.
mathematical_scope.coefficients: The regression test proves P.extMk(c followed by g) = -(hS.extClass.comp (Ext.mk0 g)) for arbitrary coefficient morphisms g.
